polyfy/polylith.probeResult: PASS (printed OK at the pinned revision)
polyfy/polylith.note: Polylith's own workspace checker validates component/interface references across bricks. It is repository-native and is precisely the referential hazard class under test, so it is a fair surface rather than a weak stand-in for a compiler.

surfaceFairness: All three repositories in the frozen universe have a working, repository-native, deterministic validation surface at their pinned revision. Two toolchains (rustup 1.97 for syncpack, openjdk + Clojure CLI for polylith) were installed BEFORE screening specifically so that no repository would be silently unable to admit a candidate. No repository is excluded by infrastructure.
noHandAuthoredOracle: Every surface above is the repository's own. This experiment authors no invariant checker for the external universe.
